Resources designed to match teachers

The Suffix Video Conferencing Platform allows students to share their audio, images, chat, video and screen. Built-in polling makes it easy for students to engage and recording your lectures means you can make them available for later review.

Anybody can share a webcam

There's no limit to how many webcams you can share in a session (limited by bandwidth only.

Whiteboard live for presenters and groups

Annotations are automatically shown back to the students in real-time while using the whiteboard device. Presenters do have the option to zoom, highlight, draw and write on presentations to make the points easier for students who are far away.
